DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鳥に食べ物を与えないよう、こちらの案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please read this notice asking visitors not to feed the birds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少しのパンでもだめですか。子どもが鳥へあげたいと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 少量のパンを与える可否と子どもの希望を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not even a little bread? My child says they want to give some to the birds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a little bread is allowed and mention your child's wish. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この公園では、食べ物を与えずに観察するようご案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this park we ask people to observe without giving food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。まだ袋から出していません。子どもにも先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ取り出していないと伝え子どもへ案内を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. We haven't taken it out of the bag yet. I'll explain to my child first too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it hasn't been taken out and explain the notice to your child. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま袋にしまっておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep it in the bag as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもには、食べ物をあげる代わりに、遠くから見ると説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 給餌の代わりに離れて観察すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell my child we'll watch from a distance instead of feeding them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will observe from a distance instead of feeding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 鳥を追いかけず、園路からご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't chase the birds; watch from the park path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 近づけるためにパンを地面へ置くこともしません。ここから写真を撮っていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誘うために置かず遠くから撮影できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We won't put bread on the ground to attract them either. May we take photos from here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Don't leave food to lure them and ask about photos from a distance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、鳥へ近づかずお撮りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep the passage clear and take photos without approaching the birds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚撮ってから散歩を続けます。残ったパンは持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影後は散歩し食べ物を残さず持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll take one photo then continue walking. We'll take the remaining bread home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will walk after the photo and take food home without leaving it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。食べ物を残さず、観察をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11245-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Leave no food behind and enjoy observing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車の遅れについてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the train delay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。面接に行くので、何時に着くか先方へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 面接先へ到着予定を伝えたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm going to an interview and want to tell them what time I'll arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you want to give the interviewer your expected arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の運行情報はお伝えできますが、到着時刻はまだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can give current service information, but the arrival time isn't confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内にある見込みの時刻を、そのまま約束しても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運行見込みを確定の約束に使えるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is it okay to promise the estimated time in the notice exactly as it stands?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether a service estimate can be used as a firm promise. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見込みは状況によって変わります。確定した時刻とは分けてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Estimates change with conditions. Explain them separately from confirmed times.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、現在遅れていて、到着時刻は確認中だと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遅延と到着確認中の状態を先方へ伝えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll say there's a delay now and I'm checking the arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will tell them the delay and that arrival is being checked. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのうえで、先方に遅れた場合の対応を確認するとよいでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then it would be good to ask them what to do if you're late.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最新の情報が分かったら、もう一度こちらの表示を見ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最新情報を確認する表示を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I want the latest information, should I check this display again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which display gives the latest information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。放送や案内表示の更新もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Check updated announcements and information displays too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確実に着くとは言わず、分かった範囲を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確実な到着を約束せず分かる範囲を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't say I'll definitely arrive; I'll tell them what I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't promise certain arrival and will report what is known. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけて。情報が変わった場合も、必要に応じて先方へご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care. If the information changes, contact them again as needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying for a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。予約した相談に来ました。この列でよいと思って並びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約相談で列を間違えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. I came for a booked consultation. I thought this was the right queue and joined it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you came for a booked consultation and joined the wrong queue. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the appointment instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ここに相談室とあります。番号札も取ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談室の案内と取得済み番号札を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It says consultation room here. I also took a numbered ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the consultation-room information and the ticket already taken. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは証明書の窓口です。相談の受付先を案内書で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the certificate counter. Let's check the instructions for the consultation reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: もう予約時刻です。この番号が呼ばれるまで待つ必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約時刻でも今の番号を待つべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's already my appointment time. Must I wait for this number to be called?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to wait for this number even at appointment time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の受付なので、この列で待たずに相談の受付へ状況を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's a different reception; don't wait in this queue. Tell consultation reception your situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号札はどうすればいいですか。間違えて取ったと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誤取得した番号札の扱いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: What should I do with the numbered ticket? I'd like to tell them I took it by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with the ticket taken by mistake. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。まず相談の案内書を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check that here. First show me the consultation instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内です。相談先には、受付を間違えていたと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を提示し相談先にも間違いを説明すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here they are. I'll also explain to the consultation staff that I went to the wrong reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the instructions and say you will explain the mistake to the consultation staff. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談の受付先をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to consultation reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の内容についてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。今日の金額と、この領収書の金額が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払額と手元の領収書が違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Today's amount differs from the amount on this receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the payment amount and the receipt you have differ. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書の日付を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I check the receipt date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あ、これは先月のものです。財布に入っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 領収書が前回の日付だと気づいて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oh, this is last month's. It was in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice and explain that the receipt is from the previous date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日お渡ししたものは、別にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have the one we gave you today separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒にありました。こちらは今日の日付です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日分を見つけて提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was in this envelope. This one has today's date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Find and show today's receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、今日の内容はこちらで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's check today's items using this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先月と違う金額だから、間違いだとは言えないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前回との金額差だけでは誤りと判断できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So a different amount from last month doesn't itself mean a mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm a difference from last time alone doesn't prove an error. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日付や内容をそれぞれ確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We need to check the dates and contents individually.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の領収書と明細をそろえて、不明な項目を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日の明細にある不明項目の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to put today's receipt and itemized statement together and ask about unclear items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request explanations of unclear items on today's statement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず、どの項目かお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First show me which item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした物について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll ask about the item you lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 書類入りの封筒です。ただ、中にある個人情報をここで大きな声で話したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 書類をなくしたが個人情報を人前で話したくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An envelope with documents. But I don't want to talk loudly here about the personal information inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you lost documents but don't want to discuss personal information publicly. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのご希望を伺いました。まず外から分かる特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've noted your wish. First tell me its visible external features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 茶色の封筒で、角に青い印があります。名前は外に書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒の外観と氏名未記載を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: A brown envelope with a blue mark at the corner. No name is written outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the envelope exterior and absence of a written name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身を確認する必要がある場合は、伝え方をご相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If we need to check the contents, let's discuss how you can communicate them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類の番号を、このメモに書いて見せてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 識別番号をメモで伝えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I write the document number on this note and show it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may give an identification number in a note. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報を確認してから、書いていただく内容をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: After confirming what information is needed, I'll tell you what to write.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 全部の番号を先に書かず、必要な部分だけ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な情報だけ確認してから書きたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to check only the necessary parts rather than write all the numbers first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to confirm necessary information before writing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。最後に封筒を持っていた場所も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Tell me where you last had the envelope too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅前のベンチです。中身の説明は、周りに聞こえにくい方法でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最後の場所を伝え配慮した説明方法を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: A bench in front of the station. Please let me explain the contents in a way people around us can't easily hear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the last location and request a considerate way to explain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。外観と最後に持っていた状況から順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll start with the exterior and the circumstances when you last had it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再配達のお申込みについてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This concerns your redelivery request, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二時から四時を選びました。二時ちょうどに受け取れば、二時半に出かけられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 時間帯の最初に届けば外出できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I chose two to four. If I receive it exactly at two, can I go out at two thirty?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can go out if delivery arrives at the beginning of the slot. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時間帯の最初に必ず届くという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It doesn't mean it will certainly arrive at the start of the slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二時から四時の間で考える必要があるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二時間の範囲で考える必要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I need to think of it as sometime between two and four.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm you need to allow the two-hour interval. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。到着時刻を二時と確定して予定を組まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Don't make plans treating the arrival time as definitely two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二時半から外出するなら、その時間帯を待てる予定ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中外出では在宅条件に合わないと整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I'm going out from two thirty, I won't be available to wait through that slot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Recognize going out during the slot doesn't meet the at-home condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご在宅になれる時間帯か、改めてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check again whether you can be home throughout that time slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外出を別の日にできるか確認します。今の申込みは、もう完了しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外出調整の意向と申込完了済みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll see whether I can go out another day. My current request is already complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you intend to adjust the outing and that the request is already submitted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込み済みの内容も見せてください。変更する場合は、その扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Show the submitted details too. If changing them, we'll check how to handle that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に外出の予定を調整します。待てない場合は、今の申込みを確認してから変更を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待てない場合は既存申込の変更を相談すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first adjust my outing. If I can't wait, I'll check the current request before asking about changing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will consult about changing the existing request if you can't wait. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。時間帯全体で受け取れる予定を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Confirm plans that let you receive it throughout the slot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失についてですね。すでに連絡はされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about a lost card. Have you already contacted us?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、ウェブで連絡したつもりです。ただ、受付の番号が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 連絡したつもりだが受付番号がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I'd contacted you online yesterday, but can't find an acceptance number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you thought you contacted them but lack an acceptance number. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの画面を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I check the screen you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。今見ると「下書き」とあります。最後の送信はしていなかったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面が下書きで送信不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. Looking now it says 'Draft.' I may not have done the final submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the screen is a draft and submission is uncertain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 下書きの画面だけでは、紛失連絡の受付や停止の完了を確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: A draft screen alone doesn't confirm acceptance of a loss report or completion of blocking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入力しただけで止まったと思っていました。現在の状態を調べて、必要な停止を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入力だけで停止したと誤解したことを訂正し対応を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought just entering it stopped the card. I'd like to check the current status and discuss any necessary blocking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the mistaken belief that entry alone blocked it and request action. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認のうえ、担当が確認します。カードは今も見当たりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: After identity verification, the staff will check. Is the card still missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。まだありません。昨日使った後、夜にないことに気付きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カード未発見と気づいた経過を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, still missing. I used it yesterday and noticed at night it was gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the card hasn't been found and explain when you noticed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その経過も伺います。画面は下書きのままお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll ask about that history too. Show the screen as the draft it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。停止済みとは言わず、今の状態を確認して結果の案内を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止済みと断言せず現状と結果を確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I won't say it's already blocked; I'll confirm the current status and receive the result information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't assert blocking is complete and will confirm status and result. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎして、受付と停止の状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you with the staff to check acceptance and blocking status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: パンについてのご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。袋にいちごの写真があります。中にいちごが入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装の果物写真が中身を示すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There's a strawberry photo on the bag. Are there strawberries inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the fruit photo on the package indicates the contents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品名と原材料の表示を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the product name and ingredients together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 商品名はいちご風味です。「風味」は果物そのものという意味ではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 風味という名称と果物そのものの違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The name is strawberry flavored. 'Flavored' doesn't mean the actual fruit itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the difference between a flavor name and actual fruit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真やその言葉だけで、果肉が入っているとは決められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The photo or that word alone doesn't establish that there is fruit pulp inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 果肉があるパンを探しています。原材料のどこを見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 果肉入りを希望し原材料表示の見方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm looking for bread with fruit pulp. Where should I look in the ingredients?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want fruit pulp and ask how to read the ingredients. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの表示をご覧ください。内容について不明なら確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Look at this label. If anything about the contents is unclear, I'll check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この商品は私の希望と違いそうなので、別のパンを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希望に合う別の商品を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This seems different from what I want, so I'd like to look at other bread.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will seek another product matching your wish. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。別の商品でも表示を一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. We can check other products' labels together too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次は写真だけで選ばず、商品名と中身の表示を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真に加えて名称と内容表示を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next time I won't choose from photos alone; I'll read the product name and contents label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the name and contents as well as photos. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。分からない点は購入前にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Ask about anything unclear before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内をご利用になる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to use the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。閉園は五時とあります。五時までに入れば、後で出てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉園前に入れば閉園後に出られるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says closing is at five. If I enter by five, may I leave later?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether entering before closing allows leaving after closing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 閉園時刻までに外へ出る予定でご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Use it with plans to be outside by closing time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口に入る締切だと思っていました。今から池まで往復できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入場締切と取り違えたと説明し往復の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was the last entry time. Can I go to the pond and back now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain confusing it with entry cutoff and ask whether a round trip is possible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩く速さや休憩にもよります。戻る時間を含めて考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It depends on walking speed and rests too. Include the return time in your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時計は四時半です。途中で写真を撮るので、長くなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在時刻と撮影で時間が延びることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's four thirty now. I'll take photos on the way, so it may take longer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the current time and that photography adds time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、池までの往復にこだわらず近い場所を選んではいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then rather than insist on the pond round trip, why not choose somewhere nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口に近い花壇を見て、四時五十分には戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 近い花壇と戻る目標時刻を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to see the flowerbed near the entrance and return by four fifty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest the nearby flowerbed and target return time. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この道で花壇へ行けます。時刻を確認しながらご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This path leads to the flowerbed. Check the time while you use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。閉園前に出られる短い散歩にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 閉園前に出る短い散歩にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll take a short walk that allows leaving before closing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will make it a short walk leaving before closing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。入る時刻だけでなく、お帰りの時間もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11246-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Check your return time as well as the time you enter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待ち合わせの場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your meeting point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。父は駅前にいると言いますが、私からは父の車が見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えの車が見えない状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My father says he's in front of the station, but I can't see his car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you can't see the car picking you up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駅には二つの出口があります。お父様はどちらか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The station has two exits. Do you know which he's at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「バスの前」とだけ聞きました。私がいる出口の名前を父に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 曖昧な目印ではなく自分の出口名を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only heard 'in front of the bus.' I'd like to tell him the name of my exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your exit name rather than an unclear landmark. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では、こちらは東口です。車での待機場所は別に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this situation, this is the east exit. The car waiting location needs separate checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では東口と連絡します。父が運転中なら、返事を急かさず止まってから確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運転中の相手に返事を急がせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell him the east exit. If he's driving, I won't rush his reply; I'll ask him to check after stopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you won't rush a reply from someone driving. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。お客様も移動し続けず、場所を決めて待った方が合流しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Rather than keep moving yourself, choosing a place to wait makes meeting easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父は西口だと返事をくれました。二人とも同時に反対側へ動かないよう、私だけ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の出口を確認し自分だけ移動すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Father replied he's at the west exit. I'll move alone so we don't both head to opposite sides at once.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the other person's exit and decide to move alone. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。西口へは駅の通路をご利用ください。乗車する場所はお父様と確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Use the station passage to the west exit. Check the pickup spot with your father.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。父には動かず待ってもらい、私は通路を通って西口に着いたら連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通路で移動し到着後に連絡する計画を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand. I'll ask him to stay put, go through the passage, and contact him once I reach the west exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize the plan to use the passage and contact after arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。こちらの通路を進んでください。西口の表示が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12202-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Follow this passage. There are west-exit signs.
